title: See what the fleet is costing

captures.name: tiles
captures.title: The fleet in four numbers
captures.body: Sessions running now, sessions waiting on you, machines online, and the all-time total. They read zero until your first run.

captures.name: periods
captures.title: Is today busier than usual?
captures.body: The same count over today, yesterday, this week and this month. One day on its own means little; next to the others it tells you whether the fleet is speeding up.

captures.name: windows
captures.title: Tokens by time window
captures.body: The same usage read over the last hour, day, week and month, split into input, output and cached tokens. Cached tokens are re-read context and cost a fraction of fresh input.

captures.name: analytics
captures.title: Where the tokens went
captures.body: Daily volume and a per-model breakdown, so an expensive habit shows up before the bill does. A model you did not mean to use is usually visible here first.
